pretreatments.description: Mechanical shredding of zucchini stem (ZS) into particles about 3-5 mm prior to anaerobic digestion
KOH pretreatment with concentrations ranging from 1% to 4% (mass fraction)
Ca(OH)_2 pretreatment with concentrations ranging from 1% to 4% (mass fraction)
NaOH pretreatment with concentrations ranging from 1% to 4% (mass fraction)
AHP pretreatment with concentration of 4% (mass fraction) and pH adjusted to 11.5
HCl pretreatment with concentration of 3% (mass fraction)
Microwave pretreatment with power levels ranging from 300 W to 700 W for 10 minutes at 95% moisture content
